subcommands.name: create-ledger
subcommands.description: Creates a new ledger in your Amazon Web Services account in the current Region

options.name: --permissions-mode

options.name: --deletion-protection
options.description: Specifies whether the ledger is protected from being deleted by any user.

options.name: --no-deletion-protection
options.description: Specifies whether the ledger is protected from being deleted by any user.

options.name: --kms-key

subcommands.name: export-journal-to-s3
subcommands.description: Exports journal contents within a date and time range from a ledger into a specified Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket.

options.description: The name of the ledger

options.description: The inclusive start date and time for the range of journal contents to export.

options.name: --exclusive-end-time
options.description: The exclusive end date and time for the range of journal contents to export.

options.name: --s3-export-configuration

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that grants QLDB permissions for a journal export job to do the following: Write objects into your Amazon S3 bucket.
